description: Defines enums, structs, and inline functions related to PUCCH (Physical Uplink Control Channel) configuration and resource mapping in 3GPP LTE/5G NR, including hopping configurations, resource set indices, formats, and resource IDs.

classes.name: pucch_res_id_t
classes.description: Structure representing PUCCH resource IDs for cell and UE, with comparison operators.

methods.name: pucch_res_set_idx_to_uint
methods.description: Converts pucch_res_set_idx enum to its uint8_t representation.

methods.name: pucch_format_to_uint
methods.description: Converts pucch_format enum to its uint8_t representation.

methods.name: to_string (pucch_format)
methods.description: Returns string representation of pucch_format enum.

methods.name: to_string (pucch_formats)
methods.description: Returns string representation of pucch_formats enum.

methods.name: pucch_f0f1_format
methods.description: Determines pucch_format for Resource Set ID 0 based on pucch_formats.

methods.name: pucch_f2f3f4_format
methods.description: Determines pucch_format for Resource Set ID 1 based on pucch_formats.
